nodes.text: But he said, "Because I do not revere idols made with hands, but the living God, who created heaven and earth and has lordship over all flesh."
And Daniel laughed, and held back the king from going inside, and said, "Look now at the floor, and know whose footprints these are."
And the king, enraged, then arrested the priests and their wives and children, and they showed him the secret doors through which they used to go in and consume what was on the table.
And the king killed them, and handed Bel over to Daniel; and he overthrew it and its temple.
And there was a great dragon, and the Babylonians revered it.
And the king said to Daniel, "You cannot say that this is not a living god; so worship it."
And Daniel said, "I will worship the Lord my God, for he is a living God."

And Daniel took pitch and fat and hair, and boiled them together and made cakes, and put [them] into the mouth of the dragon; and when it had eaten, the dragon burst open. And he said, "See the objects of your worship."
